| 7                | -        | -        | -        | Pass       | Pass       | Execute audible and visual alarm tests only |

| 9                | -        | -        | -        | -          | Fail       | Report visual alarm test failure |
|10                | -        | -        | -        | -          | Pass       | Confirm all visual alarms work |
|11                | -        | -        | -        | Pass       | Fail       | Confirm all audible alarm devices work |
|12                | -        | -        | -        | -          | Pass       | Confirm all visual alarms work (user confirmation) |
|13                | -        | -        | -        | -          | -          | No action (all conditions unspecified, verify no impact) |

Note: "-" indicates a "don't-care" condition, meaning the outcome of that condition does not affect the action taken.
